title.en: Koenigsegg's 600 hp three-cylinder has no camshaft 🤯 #shorts
title.id: Mesin 3 silinder Koenigsegg 600 hp, tanpa noken as 🤯 #shorts

description.en: Koenigsegg's 2-litre, three-cylinder Tiny Friendly Giant makes 600 hp without a camshaft. Its Freevalve system opens every valve with its own pneumatic-hydraulic-electric actuator, so the engine computer sets timing, lift and duration valve by valve.
description.id: Mesin Tiny Friendly Giant Koenigsegg, 2 liter tiga silinder, tembus 600 hp tanpa noken as. Sistem Freevalve buka tiap katup pakai aktuator pneumatik-hidraulik-elektrik sendiri, jadi komputer mesin ngatur waktu, angkatan, dan lamanya katup terbuka satu per satu.

scenes.en: This engine has *no camshaft*, and it makes *600 horsepower* from three cylinders.
scenes.id: Mesin ini *nggak punya noken as*, tapi tenaganya *600 hp* dari tiga silinder.

scenes.en: Normally a spinning *camshaft* opens every valve, on a fixed schedule set by the shape of its lobes.
scenes.id: Biasanya *noken as* yang muter buka semua katup, jadwalnya tetap sesuai bentuk tonjolannya.

scenes.en: Koenigsegg's *Freevalve* throws that away. Each valve gets its own *actuator*, driven by air, oil and electronics.
scenes.id: *Freevalve* Koenigsegg buang itu. Tiap katup punya *aktuator* sendiri, digerakkan udara, oli, dan elektronik.

scenes.en: The engine computer decides, for every valve, *when* it opens, *how far*, and for *how long*.
scenes.id: Komputer mesin yang nentuin tiap katup: *kapan* buka, *seberapa lebar*, dan *berapa lama*.

scenes.en: It's a *2-litre* twin-turbo, built for the *Gemera*, a four-seat hybrid.
scenes.id: Mesinnya *2 liter* twin-turbo, buat *Gemera*, mobil hybrid empat kursi.

scenes.en: Freevalve says this control can even replace parts like the *throttle body*.
scenes.id: Kata Freevalve, kontrol ini bahkan bisa gantiin part kayak *throttle body*.

scenes.en: No camshaft in an engine: *future*, or *too fragile*?
scenes.id: Mesin tanpa noken as: *masa depan* atau *gampang rusak*?
